> 第681章 完结感言（第1页）
沧源发现，在无自己的掌控之后，自己的三十六座体内世界进入到了一种无序的演变过程。
“本帝这这些个世界中，兴许能走出几个能与本帝并肩的小家伙也说不定呢。”
就比如，沧源发现了一个丧尸蓝星。
他叫陆宁。（作者的第一本末世书，可惜被关小黑屋了，也不知道还有没有人记得，叫：《末世：混日子的那些年》
率领蓝星人类杀进了浩瀚的星海寰宇之中。
这个世界也有个年轻人叫陆宁，他召唤地府众多阴神，平定了这方世界的诡异动乱。
有意思的是，蓝星之外，无垠星空之中，九大平行世界之中，也有黑潮动乱。
（这是作者第二本书，叫：《开局亲吻女鬼，没想到她竟是女帝！》这本书作者本来打算也写到一百多万字的，但在七十多万字的时候出了意外，被平台制裁了，只能草草完结。）
总之，三十六座世界，经历了诸多演变之后，皆有不同的变化。
有望冲破沧源世界的桎梏，真正的踏足这神话世界！
总不能还像在洪荒一样，沧源是大罗仙，三十六尊世界化身也是大罗仙吧？
沧源以绝对的高位俯瞰着诸天寰宇万界。
以在观察自己三十六座体内世界的变化。
就像一尊至高无上的创造者，在俯瞰自己的微观世界一样。
完结感言：本书从去年九月开书写到现在，也快有一年时间了，作者是天天更新，一天都不敢落下啊，就我这么敬业的作者，难道不配在这最后的关键时刻，赚你们一波书评嘛！！！！
对于这本书，其实并没有按照作者设想的方向发展写完，中间最起码差了二三百章的内容剧情，但由于作者能力有限，也可能是第一次对百万字以后的大长篇把握不住，从出了洪荒开始就有些写崩了。
按照现在的流量来说继续水，继续流水账对我而言还是有收益的，但是那样我自己写着痛苦，对你们也不负责，所以疼痛完结啦。
对此，作者深感抱歉，没能给兄弟姐妹们一个完美的结局。

不过慢慢来，作者迟早能驾驭一百万的节奏，二百万字的节奏，甚至是三百万字的节奏！
往后，关于沧源的故事，就像这最后写的一样，他将是一切的创造者，以一个绝对的高度姿态俯瞰一切。
后续的主角，也将在沧源的三十六座体内世界中诞生，甚至是沧源世界化身诞生的灵智，等等等等可能。
以前还是以后，现在的沧源，都是作者这里最高的山！
祝愿你们身体健康，万事如意，升职加薪，学业有成，财源广进。
实在不行，祝你们每人都获得一个系统算了。

> Chapter 681 Final Remarks (Page 1)
Cangyuan discovered that without his control, his thirty-six inner worlds entered a disorderly evolution process.
"In these worlds of this emperor, there may be a few little guys who can stand shoulder to shoulder with me."
For example, Cangyuan discovered a zombie Blue Star.
His name is Lu Ning. (The author’s first apocalyptic book was unfortunately locked up in a dark room. I don’t know if anyone still remembers it. It was called: “The Apocalypse: Those Years of Drowsiness”
Lead the Blue Star humans into the vast star sea world.
There is also a young man named Lu Ning in this world. He summoned many underworld gods to calm down the strange turmoil in this world.
What's interesting is that beyond the Blue Star, in the boundless starry sky, and in the nine parallel worlds, there is also black tide turmoil.
(This is the author's second book, called: "Kissing a Female Ghost at the Beginning, Unexpectedly She Was the Empress!" The author originally planned to write more than one million words for this book, but an accident occurred when he was about 700,000 words long, and he was sanctioned by the platform, so he could only finish it hastily.)
In short, the thirty-six worlds have undergone different changes after undergoing many evolutions.
It is expected to break through the shackles of the Cangyuan world and truly set foot in this mythical world!
It can't be like in the prehistoric times, Cangyuan is the Great Luo Immortal, and the thirty-six world incarnations are also the Great Luo Immortal, right?
Cangyuan overlooks the world from an absolutely high position.
In order to observe the changes in the world inside the thirty-six seats of oneself.
It's like a supreme creator overlooking his own microscopic world.
Final words: It has been almost a year since I started writing this book in September last year. The author updates it every day and never dares to miss a day. As a dedicated author like me, don’t I deserve to earn a wave of book reviews from you at this last critical moment? ! ! !
In fact, this book was not completed in the direction the author envisioned. There was at least two to three hundred chapters missing in the middle. However, due to the author's limited ability, it may be the first time that he was unable to grasp a long novel with more than one million words, so he started to fail in writing.
According to the current flow rate, it will still be profitable for me to continue running the water and running the accounts, but then I will write the pain myself and I will not be responsible for you, so the pain is over.
The author is deeply sorry for not being able to give the brothers and sisters a perfect ending.
But take your time, and sooner or later the author will be able to control the rhythm of one million words, the rhythm of two million words, or even the rhythm of three million words!
From now on, the story about Cangyuan will be like this last one. He will be the creator of everything, overlooking everything from an absolute height.
The subsequent protagonists will also be born in the thirty-six inner worlds of Cangyuan, and even the spiritual wisdom born in the incarnation of Cangyuan world, and so on.
Cangyuan, before or in the future, is the highest mountain here for the author!
I wish you good health, all the best, promotion and salary increase, academic success, and abundant financial resources.
If it doesn't work, I hope each of you can get a system.
